observations.why: Speaker enacts hierarchy by issuing a directive that sets a binding cadence for the organization.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Speaker leverages hierarchical footing to define reality for the group — what counts as genuinely possessing a capability — a rank-based definitional act, not a communal claim.
Declarative specification of cadence enacts authority-ranking: the position-holder sets the operating rhythm for the organization.
Assigning a named owner is a rank-based allocation of responsibility — authority-ranking enacted through role designation.
